title: Verwijzing naar de data van: NSCR School project - inventarisation school reactions to problem behavior
descriptions: NSCR-Schoolproject is the umbrella for a research program with four partial studies, aimed at enhancing insights into the development of delinquency and other problem behavior of adolescents, and the role of peer network formation among students, psycho-social development, and reactions from the school on problem behavior. The NSCR Schoolproject aimed to enhance insights into the complicated relations between delinquency and other problem behaviors, psycho-social development, peer networks, and school informal interventions. Interview data . In this subproject we analyzed intervention strategies of schools with regard to problem behavior of students. The aim was to assess what schools perceive as problem behavior and how they react on it. Interviews were held with staff members of each school.
Data available in consultation with NSCR. Please contact the datamanager [datamanagement@nscr.nl]

data_sources: Primarily preporatory vocational (vmbo) secondary schools from the province South Holland (45 interviews). During the inventory, interviews were held at 'key persons' at each school. These could differ among schools, but the director was always included. Usually also one school grade coordinator and one mentor was included.
